scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.backend: cd backend && (test -d venv || python3 -m venv venv) && . venv/bin/activate && python main.py
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
